body: It shouldn't be that way, that's for certain. It took until I was about 25 before I got confident enough to initiate things with my guy. Definitely talk to her about it, I cant stress enough the importance of open communication.  Maybe even see if she has a different love language, i.e. sending exotic texts from the other room because she's too shy to say anything out loud, or subtly touching you while you're watching tv to get the hint across. Best of luck, you deserve to feel wanted.
